title: A Wanderer's Honor - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: A Wanderer's Honor trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: A Wanderer's Honor phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. Same window as The Journey Home - both start in the Village of Lu, so both should be finished before moving on.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete the side quest Young Master Lan.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 22 of 36 on the list - before it Together Till the End · after it Spectral Blade. It is missable, and the checklist of everything that expires is on the guide. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
